versions.changelog:
- Initial release of token-cost-skill.
- Supports calculating and reviewing token billing for OpenAI-style APIs and NewAPI-compatible gateways.
- Differentiates between raw pricing, quota-based billing, and dashboard-specific cost projections.
- Provides core rules to avoid double-counting cached tokens and to prevent mixing incompatible pricing units.
- Includes detailed formulas, verification checklist, and common mistake handling for accurate token billing.
